data.situation:
Back at the centre, Jo placed a short questionnaire on a clipboard beside the reading-room door. Each respondent could leave a question unanswered. They would ask visitors on two afternoons, so their sample would be small. Maya introduced a new seating plan only after the first afternoon. Her observation of the original room would give them something to compare it with. Reading-room questionnaire
Where did you sit today?
What made you choose that seat?
You may skip any question. Please put the paper in the folder when you finish. Maya: We made this questionnaire specifically for the seating project.
Jo: Which variable are we changing?
Maya: The positions of the chairs. We should write down other changes, too.
Jo: And if different people come on the second day?
Maya: Then we must mention that when we discuss the results.

readingBlocks.en: Back at the centre, Jo placed a short questionnaire on a clipboard beside the reading-room door. Each respondent could leave a question unanswered. They would ask visitors on two afternoons, so their sample would be small. Maya introduced a new seating plan only after the first afternoon. Her observation of the original room would give them something to compare it with.
readingBlocks.zh: 回到中心，乔在阅览室门边的写字板上放了一份简短问卷。每位受访者都可以跳过问题。她们会询问两个下午的访客，因此样本很小。玛雅直到第一个下午结束才引入新的座位方案。对原房间的观察将提供比较的基础。

readingBlocks.en:
Reading-room questionnaire
Where did you sit today?
What made you choose that seat?
You may skip any question. Please put the paper in the folder when you finish.
readingBlocks.zh:
阅览室问卷
今天你坐在哪里？
什么原因让你选择那个座位？
你可以跳过任何问题。填完请把纸放进文件夹。
readingBlocks.title: On the clipboard

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: We made this questionnaire specifically for the seating project.
Jo: Which variable are we changing?
Maya: The positions of the chairs. We should write down other changes, too.
Jo: And if different people come on the second day?
Maya: Then we must mention that when we discuss the results.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：这份问卷是专门为座位项目制作的。
乔：我们改变的是哪个变量？
玛雅：椅子的位置。其他变化也应该记下。
乔：如果第二天来的是不同的人呢？
玛雅：那讨论结果时就必须提到。

glossary.zh: 用于收集信息的一组书面问题；问卷

externalEvidence.definition: a form containing a set of questions; submitted to people to gain statistical information

glossary.zh: 回应调查问题的受访者
glossary.note: 此处为调查应答者，不是法律被告。
glossary.example: Each respondent may skip a question.
glossary.exampleZh: 每位受访者可以跳过一个问题。

glossary.zh: 从整体中选取供研究的一小部分；样本
glossary.note: 本例为调查人群的子集；不是试吃品或动词。
glossary.example: Their sample includes visitors from two afternoons.
glossary.exampleZh: 样本包括两个下午的访客。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Selected visitor subset, not random selection as the narrower local sense assumes.

glossary.zh: 仔细观察的行为或过程
glossary.note: 此处观察过程；不是发表一条评论。
glossary.example: Observation began before the chairs were moved.
glossary.exampleZh: 移动椅子之前，观察就开始了。

externalEvidence.definition: the act of observing; taking a patient look

glossary.note: introduce a plan/system；不是介绍两个人认识。
glossary.example: Maya introduced a new seating plan.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅引入新的座位方案。

externalEvidence.definition: bring something new to an environment

glossary.example: They wrote the questions specifically for this project.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们专门为这个项目编写问题。

glossary.zh: 可能变化或被改变的因素；变量
glossary.note: 本例为研究中改变的因素。
glossary.example: The positions of the chairs are one variable.
glossary.exampleZh: 椅子的位置是一个变量。

externalEvidence.definition: something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation
